published_catalogue.estimator: scipy.odr on the UNBINNED 2693 points, errors in BOTH variables, fitting g_obs = g_bar/(1-exp(-sqrt(g_bar/g_dagger)))
published_catalogue.sample: 153 galaxies / 2693 points; reject i<30 deg (10 gal), Q=3 (12 gal), require dV_obs/V_obs < 0.10
published_catalogue.verbatim: 'The data are fitted using the Python orthogonal distance regression algorithm (scipy.odr), considering errors in both variables.' / 'We do not fit the binned data, but the individual 2693 points.'

published_catalogue.family: RAR-CURVE-FIT / orthogonal distance regression (SAME estimator as PRL)
published_catalogue.estimator: identical scipy.odr fit; this is the long-form companion of the PRL
published_catalogue.verbatim: same ODR sentence; extended relation incl. ultrafaint dwarfs gives g_dagger = (1.1 +- 0.1)e-10

published_catalogue.family: PER-GALAXY MCMC with g_dagger FIXED or GAUSSIAN-PRIORED
published_catalogue.estimator: per-galaxy MCMC marginalising over Upsilon, D, i; g_dagger is NOT an independent output -- fiducial fits FIX g_dagger = 1.20e-10, and the free-g_dagger test uses a Gaussian prior centred on 1.20e-10
published_catalogue.sample: 175 galaxies fitted; 153 in the quality sample
published_catalogue.verbatim: 'adjusting the value of g_dagger improves neither the fits nor the rms scatter' -- i.e. this paper INHERITS 1.20e-10, it does not measure it

published_catalogue.estimator: fit M_b = A*V_f^4 (slope FIXED at 4) -> a0 = chi/(G*A) with a disk geometry factor chi ~ 0.8; A = 47 +- 6 Msun km^-4 s^4
published_catalogue.sample: gas-rich galaxies (V_f from HI); SPARC version uses Vflat
published_catalogue.ml: gas-dominated selection minimises the Upsilon lever by construction
published_catalogue.verbatim: 'M_b = A V_f^4 with A = 47 +- 6 Msun km^-4 s^4, which is equivalent to MOND with a0 = 1.3 +- 0.3 x 10^-10 m/s^2'
